newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse trade slowsdown for summer holidays.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse trade slowsdown for summer holidays.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.36 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 443.35 points, down from 444.97 on Thursday.
Total volume was 196,750 dinars against 1.75 million dinars.
"There were few contracts because of the summer holidays with investors preferring beaches to deals on the bourse," a broker said.
Airline Tunis Air was down 0.18 dinar to 18.82 dinars with 2,043 shares cxhanging hands.
BNDT bank was up 0.15 dinar to 8.15 dinars despite the announcement that its pretax profits during the first half of 1997 fell by 62.9 percent compared to the same period last year.
